purpose: Teach: 泙/蹐/癲/腓/磴/曚/儖/蕁

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の水中異音、つまり泙の鑑別を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll conduct a careful differential diagnosis of the water sounds—what we call aqueous murmurs—as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady pace. Compassionate but clinical tone. Slight pause before the clarification, as if translating a difficult concept for understanding.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の跼蹐、つまり蹐の姿勢を医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be observing the patient's posture and gait carefully—the positioning and movement patterns—across the medical team.
lines.style: Even delivery, slightly slower. Methodical precision in each phrase. The clarification in parentheses delivered with extra care, ensuring comprehension without condescension.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、癲癇、つまり癲発作の治療を医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Ren, we're continuing treatment for the seizures—the epileptic episodes—as a coordinated medical team.
lines.style: Measured, firm. Weight on 「continuing」 to convey ongoing commitment. Warm underneath the clinical language. No rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、術後の腓腹筋、つまり腓のリハビリを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be working on rehabilitation for the calf muscle—post-operative recovery—together as your medical team.
lines.style: Slightly softer than the others. Gentle emphasis on the rehabilitation pathway. Patient, not rushed. The reassurance that this is shared work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、転倒事故の磴、つまり石段からの落下を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Ren, regarding the fall from the stone steps—we're addressing the injury carefully as a full medical team.
lines.style: Grounded, direct. A moment of stillness at the opening. Calm but not detached. The weight of the incident acknowledged without alarm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、夜勤帯、つまり曚気時の体調変化を医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be monitoring how your condition changes during night shifts—the evening hours—with close observation from the team.
lines.style: Slower cadence. Thoughtful spacing between clauses. Acknowledges the specific vulnerability of night-shift exhaustion. Warm, not clinical.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の儖、つまり儖の体格を医療チームで記録します
lines.en: Ren, we're documenting the patient's physical build and condition—the body composition data—carefully with the team.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, efficient. No unnecessary emotion, but not cold. The procedural nature delivered as simply necessary care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、蕁麻疹、つまり蕁の急性反応を医療チームで治療します
lines.en: Ren, we'll treat the hives—the acute allergic reaction—promptly as a medical team.
lines.style: Efficient, slightly quickened. Practical tone. The reassurance that this is manageable. Close warmth at the end, as if wrapping up the conversation with care.
